run_kappa_thermal_conductivity: run the KappaRunner calculate method to compute thermal conductivity for a list of atomic structures
create_kappa_runner: create a KappaRunner instance with an ASE calculator and input atomic structures for thermal conductivity calculations
load_kappa_data_list: load atomic structures from an extxyz file using get_kappa103_data_list for kappa calculations
write_kappa_results: write kappa calculation results to a gzipped JSON file using the write_results method
review_kappa_runner_calculate: review the KappaRunner calculate method which performs structure relaxation, force constant computation, and thermal conductivity calculation
